text_block_list.text:
After our outing, on the way back to the 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa. The line at this ramen shop is 
crazy long again today.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten super popular, after all. 
Guess we just gotta wait in line. My 
stomach's already completely set on ramen 
from here anyway.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...A while back, Oguri recommended that 
ramen shop to me saying it was delicious, 
so I've been a bit curious about it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I really can't stand 
standin' in lines! Waitin' around quietly 
just ain't in my nature!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, it feels bad to turn down food 
someone recommended to ya, so I've been 
wonderin' what to do—"
choice_data_list: Shall we try lining up together, then?

Do you want to try lining up together, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
choice_data_list:
I thought the line might move faster while 
we chat.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's it!!

"And so, standing in line with Inari One, 
the topic of conversation that came to 
mind was—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm standing in line for ramen and 
all, but... when it comes to my real 
favorite food, it's gotta be soba!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I love it enough to eat it every day, so 
back home, I actually learned a bit about 
how to make it myself.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't great around the kitchen, but 
when it comes to soba, I'm pretty 
confident I can make a decent bowl."
choice_data_list:
It's amazing that you can make it 
yourself!

It's amazing that you can make it 
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, it's strictly amateur work. Can't 
compare to the stuff from a real store.
choice_data_list: I kind of want to try some...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you sure have curious taste! Though 
hearing you say that just makes me want to 
live up to it, you know—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll cook for ya next time. And 
if I'm doing it, I'm gonna make sure it's 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Boss, what kind of soba do you 
like? Just asking for reference, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Sis, what kind of soba do you 
like? Just asking for reference, y'know.

"And so, the conversation with Inari One 
became lively around the topic of soba—"

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Party of two, thank you for waiting! 
Right this way, please!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? It's my turn already?! That went by 
in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, guess I'd better switch my 
stomach from soba mode to ramen mode!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the fooood! ...Wait, hey!

After waiting in line together, it turned 
out to be a day that made me feel just a 
little bit closer to Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, the sauna at the public 
bathhouse I usually go to has been under 
repair lately, which is a real pain.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A hot bath is great, but saunas feel 
awesome too. There's actually a lot of 
depth to taking one properly.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When ya follow the proper steps an' savor 
it properly... lemme tell ya, it feels 
downright heavenly...!
choice_data_list:
...Somehow, I kind of want to hit the 
sauna now.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds good! I'll recommend you a 
great sauna later, then! Nothing feels 
better after a long day of work!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I've already scouted out every bathhouse 
around here! There's nothing about baths 
and saunas that Lady Inari doesn't know!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What kind of bath do you like, Boss? Come 
to think of it, I've never asked you 
before.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of baths do you like, Big Sis? 
Come to think of it, I've never actually 
asked you before."

And with that, the conversation with Inari 
One grew lively over the topics of baths 
and saunas—

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
—Party of two, thank you for waiting! 
Right this way, please!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? It's my turn already?! That went by 
in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well then, time to savor this bowl 
recommended by Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the fooood! ...Wait, hey!

After waiting in line together, it turned 
out to be a day that made me feel just a 
little bit closer to Inari One—
